oncall-bot: Pager: 2xx5 - PrivateLink connectivity degradation reported by customer 'AcmeCorp' in az3 (us-west-2). Severity: Sev2. Symptoms: DNS failures for privatelink endpoint, intermittent egress to internet. ---------------- marta: I'm on it. seeing spike in DNS NXDOMAIN from az3 PL endpoints. svc-meter shows latency +5x for privatelink DNS responses. ---------------- raj: confirmed, CloudProvider metrics show DNS resolver errors and increased TCP retransmits from az3 -> resolver cluster. ---------------- lee: are customers seeing data plane disconnects or only DNS? ---------------- jamie-cs: Acme reporting synths failing and intermittent API errors for chat endpoints. They have fallbacks but it's hitting their SLA. ---------------- marta: quick ask: can we force egress to az1 for that customer's privatelink? route tables allow it if we tweak the private connectivity policy. I'll attempt a temporary route override. ---------------- infra-sre: heads up, changing propagation for the privatelink route will affect traffic for other customers in same subnet if not scoped. Need to scope to Acme's endpoints. ---------------- marta: doing scoped route override now for Acme (private-ip-range 10.12.0.0/20). Command I'm running: ```cloudctl routes update --scope acme-id --route 10.12.0.0/20 --next-hop az1-gw --no-propagation``` ---------------- deploy-bot: Command queued: cloudctl routes update --scope acme-id --route 10.12.0.0/20 --next-hop az1-gw --no-propagation (run by marta) ---------------- marta: route change applied. waiting for BGP/route convergence. ---------------- lee: checking traffic metrics — I see delta in egress via az1 for acme. packet loss drops from 8% -> 1% after the change. ---------------- jamie-cs: telling Acme to validate - asked them to run a single request loop. ---------------- Acme_Support (external): confirms improved for a minute, then DNS NXDOMAIN again. They see flapping every ~45s. ---------------- raj: sounds like TTL or resolver upstream issue, maybe returning SERVFAIL intermittently. I'm opening ticket with CloudProvider DNS ops: CP case #CP-84291. ---------------- marta: temporary mitigation 2: configure DNS caching on the privatelink endpoint host side to mask the flaps. Suggest TTL caching ~60s and fallback to az1 resolver. I'll prepare a small config change we can push via puppet. ---------------- infra-sre: we should also enable our fallback policy to hit the public endpoint via NAT if PrivateLink is unavailable — need approval due to data path change. ---------------- lee: approve fallback for Acme for the duration of the incident. They signed DPA allowing failover to internet for testing. ---------------- marta: pushing DNS cache config to mux service: ```/etc/privatelink/resolver.conf
cache-ttl 60
fallback-resolvers 169.254.169.253,8.8.8.8
health-check-interval 10s``` ---------------- deploy-bot: deploy started to mux fleet for scope acme-id. ---------------- deploy-bot: deploy status: 40% -> 90% -> success. ---------------- jamie-cs: Acme confirms stabilized after cache + route override. They still see occasional ~500s but overall service is back. ---------------- raj: CloudProvider responded: parser bug in their az3 DNS edge causing negative cache entries to be returned when DNSSEC revalidation hits a timeout. They're rolling a fix to az3 resolvers now. ETA 45m. ---------------- marta: good. we'll keep route override and caching until CP finishes rollout. Will document exact commands in incident. ---------------- lee: on-call handoff in 40 minutes. Marta can you take bridge until handoff? ---------------- marta: yes I can stay on bridge for next 40. After that Lee takes over. ---------------- (20 minutes later) ---------------- lee: taking over active pager. marta handing off: current mitigations in place: 1) Scoped route override to az1 (10.12.0.0/20) 2) DNS caching pushed to mux fleet 3) Fallback to public NAT allowed for Acme 4) CP rolling az3 resolver fix (ticket CP-84291) 5) Post-incident action: add alert for negative-cache spikes and a runbook for scoped route override ---------------- marta: note timestamped artifacts: route-change id rc-7789, deploy id dpl-3344, CP case CP-84291. ---------------- lee: thanks. I'll monitor until CP confirms. Can someone ping me if CP marks fixed? ---------------- raj: adding myself to bridge. also configuring a synthetic probe to check NXDOMAIN rate in az3 privatelink resolvers. ---------------- jamie-cs: Acme wants a formal incident update for their ops team. I'll draft and send 15m. ---------------- (CP fixes start rolling) ---------------- raj: metrics show NXDOMAIN rate decreasing to baseline. retran count normalizing. ---------------- oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 updated: status -> mitigated. ---------------- lee: moving to monitoring phase. Leaving route override in place for 30m post-stability. ---------------- jamie-cs: sent summary to Acme, they ack and will keep us posted. ---------------- marta: please open postmortem ticket and assign to infra-sre for root cause + durable runbooks. Also add test to smoke-suite for privatelink resolver negative cache regression. ---------------- infra-sre: will own postmortem, assign PM and add RCA timeline. ---------------- lee: closing handoff. If anyone sees anything else ping me. ---------------- jamie-cs: nice work everyone :thumbsup: ---------------- marta: final note — change to alert thresholds: raise NXDOMAIN spike alert sensitivity for az3 by 2x and add a graph panel to the console. ---------------- deploy-bot: created post-incident tasks: TASK-9874 (postmortem), TASK-9875 (runbook), TASK-9876 (alert change). ---------------- oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 status -> resolved at 1768533062. ---------------- jamie-cs: filing customer communication thread for billing/sla forgiveness request.
